author: /root/source_qualification
root_authorized_scope: Only the previously identified finalization/cleanup accounting, admitted-budget invalidation, maximum-cumulative preparation aggregation and explicit C04 preflight claims.

exact_delta.change: Optional created_paths is populated only after successful xb open; this identifies newly created budget/intent paths even if a later write fails. All receipts retain create-only writes.
New helper preserves an ordered failures list and current failure, rather than losing the original exception when budget/finalization errors occur.

New helper records whole-process RUSAGE_SELF plus reaped children, measured and .05 tail separately, same-attempt cumulative sequence and cleanup/accounting flags; over-cap adds a failure without deleting earlier reasons.

New helper retains every complete cumulative receipt pin in all_cumulative_records but exposes only maximum charged receipt per attempt (sequence tie-break) in records. Existing runtime therefore sums one chosen debit per attempt. Components must be finite, nonnegative and additive within1e-12. UNKNOWN records/unmatched intents close admission. Sum remains within the original4CPU preparation reserve.

Requires exact schema/stage, both named guards exactly true, actual CR repository/branch and matching local/owner HEAD, plus source_and_previous_backup_receipt_check==PASS before claiming receipts rechecked.
Intent write is in the handled admission path. Probe cleanup exceptions are captured; unresolved cleanup cannot produce a completed cost/admission receipt.

Host receipt, ledger, code manifest, template/budget, postwrite check and result serialization now share a bounded exception path. Cost is sampled again after the check serialization; observed tail excess raises refusal.

Only a budget created by this helper is renamed into a newly created C04_FAILED_FINALIZATION_c4_v1_<time_ns> directory. Its bytes and pin are retained; a pre-existing budget is never moved or overwritten.

One create-only amendment_1 records the cumulative current-process cost including failure handling/quarantine. Prefix and amendment are not summed. Earlier receipts, postwrite check and any partial artifacts remain unchanged.

If intent ownership, child cleanup, quarantine, failure-debit persistence or measured tail coverage cannot be established, create a unique UNKNOWN_NO_ACK record with terminal/accounting flags false and the measured current-process lower bound. A failed durable write is reported on stderr with the intent retained; no zero-cost claim or new attempt is invented.

static_resolution.basis: Cleanup exceptions and finalization serialization are handled; the finalization failure path emits one cumulative amendment or explicit UNKNOWN.

Known postwrite/tail/serialization failure moves this attempt own active budget out of the runtime path before the failure debit. Quarantine failure is explicit UNKNOWN rather than successful admission.
Exact named preflight guards/source-backup PASS/owner binding are required.
BudgetExceeded and later failures append to preserved failure history.
